summary: Iter142 (Phase-1 Iter D) — Integration health probes, idempotent alert emission, deploy-readiness rollup, targeted/TTL indexes, QA audit script, deployment checklist. All 6 backend pytest cases pass; frontend panel renders & emit button works correctly.
action_items: Review-request had a path typo: it asked for /admin/deploy-recovery but the IntegrationProbesPanel is correctly mounted on /admin/deploy-readiness (which is a separate route from /admin/deploy-recovery — that latter route is the rollback playbook page). No code fix needed — verify wording in PRD.
critical_code_review_comments: integration_health.py is well-scoped (~275 lines). Idempotency on alert_events.find_one(sort=at,-1) is correct.
ensure_alert_indexes creates compound (probe_id,at desc) which is exactly what the idempotency query needs — good.
All probes wrapped via _run_with_timeout — verified that even crashing probes return down (200), never 500.
alert_events `at` is stored as datetime, listed endpoint converts to ISO via isoformat() — correct (NOT BSON datetime in JSON).

seed_data_creation: None. Idempotency test relies on the alert_events being stable across two back-to-back calls — verified alerts_emitted=0 on 2nd call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter142 is GREEN. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_integration_health_iter142.py covers (a) 6 probes shape + status, (b) timeout safety <8s, (c) emit_alerts idempotency, (d) alerts list ISO sort+disabled-never-alerted, (e) deploy-readiness 12 checks incl. integrations_health. Frontend panel lives on /admin/deploy-readiness (NOT /admin/deploy-recovery — those are distinct pages). Targeted indexes (incidents.incident_date desc, corrective_actions.status+due_date, employees.name, field_leadership_records.occurred_at desc, operations_events.asset_id, operations_events.employee_id) and TTL indexes (admin_audit 365d, login_attempts 30d, integration_error_logs 90d, brute_force_blocks 7d, alert_events 90d) all verified directly against MongoDB. QA audit (/app/scripts/qa_audit.py → /app/QA_PERF_AUDIT.md) shows 0 ❌ in SCAN table and 0 ❌ in TTL table. /app/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md has all 7 sections (pre-flight, env diff, smoke, supervisor restart, rollback, post-deploy, known mocked).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration. The /admin/deploy-recovery vs /admin/deploy-readiness naming in the review request was a documentation slip; the implementation correctly mounts IntegrationProbesPanel under the AdminDeployReadiness page at /admin/deploy-readiness.
